newest.title: Why Google is Shuttering Jules: What Happens When Your AI Assistant Disappears
newest.description: Why Google is Shuttering Jules: What Happens When Your AI Assistant Disappears. AI agents are writing massive amounts of code, but human reviewers are drowning in the backlog. Today, we look at how to fix the bottleneck, why Google is killing its own coding agent, and how to actually hold these autonomous systems accountable. What we covered: • LinearB launches 'Agentic Studio' to manage AI agent workflows • Ebix and intentyx partner to launch SMARE for AI agent governance • Google to shutter AI coding agent Jules by year-end Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: When an AI tool you rely on gets shut down, what's your biggest concern? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
